source: FDA Facial-and-oral temperature dataset integrated in SafeSeat_ML Step 5.4.4
usage: Context only; not a medical threshold and not assumed equal to nape temperature or MLX90614 output
critical_domain_note: FDA T_atm is room-air temperature, while MLX90614 readAmbientTempC() is sensor package/die temperature Ta. They are not treated as interchangeable.
fusion_policy: MLX context change is supporting context only and cannot create WARNING/EMERGENCY by itself.
